headline: Army Officer Says His Unit Received No DepEd Confidential Funds for Youth Summits
seoTitle: Boransing: No DepEd Confidential Funds for Army Youth Summits | FMB News
seoDescription: Col. Manaros Boransing II told the Senate impeachment court that his Army unit did not receive DepEd confidential funds for youth leadership activities in 2023.
deck: Boransing said the Army funded its own participation and that his certification was not meant to validate DepEd's use of confidential funds.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Army Col. Manaros Boransing II testified during Day 20 of Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial that his unit did not receive confidential funds from the Department of Education for Youth Leadership Summit activities in 2023.

sections.heading: What the certification meant
paragraphs: Boransing said the Army certification documented participation in the activities and was not intended to certify how DepEd spent its confidential funds. He said he had no personal knowledge of DepEd's funding source for the department's own participation.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The prosecution questioned military certifications that appeared in DepEd's response to audit findings involving confidential-fund expenditures.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The testimony bears on whether military activities cited in supporting documents actually received or used the confidential funds under scrutiny. It does not by itself determine liability in the impeachment case.
